rules: Nothing posts while queue/freel/<id>.json gate != pass (3 verified references, 2+ creators, 85+ score)
Test phase: at most 2 reels live before reading results; scale to 2 a day only after the test read
Everyday problems only, sample data labeled on screen, free guide CTA; Instagram 'Comment X' only for confirmed ManyChat keywords
No claims that our internal systems work unless independently verified; ops clips parked in tools/freel/eps_hold

Hooks: never reuse the same opener two reels in a row. Rotate: question ('Think you're underpaid?'), warning ('Your medical bill might have errors'), cost reveal ('Paying only the minimum?'), 'This AI agent...'. Keep every claim true for the sample shown.
